displayDescription.en: User health profile management: create/update profiles, generate/iterate plans, log progress, and review.

displayDescription.en: Safety boundary rail: detects high-risk keywords and triggers emergency guidance to seek professional help.

displayDescription.en: Evidence-based health advisor for nutrition, sleep, emotional wellness, and personalized long-term lifestyle planning.
